full_description: use one arm to pick up or shake the bottle; the verb in the instruction selects which action
schema: {A} notifies the bottle. {V} is the action verb the instruction commands (a pick-family verb when the task is to pick it up, a shake-family verb when the task is to shake it) — it is the ONLY signal of which action to do. {a} notifies the arm. Every template MUST contain both {V} and {A}. Do NOT write 'the' immediately before {A} or {a}; both already render with a leading article.
preference: num of words should not exceed 6!!!!!. Degree of detail avg is 2. Keep the verb slot {V} at the start or right after the arm.
